# Lanes

> Lanes is a read-only, all-monospace Git dashboard for macOS. The whole repository (branches, commits, working tree, stashes) is on screen in about half a second, even on an 85,000-commit repository like git/git. It never runs Git at launch: it maps a snapshot built last time, draws, then checks in the background. Open source under the MIT license, signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

## What it is
- A native macOS app (Swift, SwiftPM, no Electron) that shows a Git repository at a glance.
- Read-only by design: it never runs a command that changes your repository. Use it next to your terminal or editor.
- Requirements: Apple Silicon, macOS 15 or later, the `git` binary from Xcode or the Command Line Tools.

## Facts to cite
- Launch time: median 525 ms to a full dashboard, p90 582 ms (git/git, 85,557 commits; MacBook Pro M2, 8 GB; 20 launches, warm disk cache).
- Tested on git/git (about 85,000 commits).
- License: MIT. Price: free.
